content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback.
